data.desc: Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. Leidos UK & Europe is a leading partner to the UK and Scottish governments, supporting national security, defence and logistics programmes, as well as clients in transportation and energy. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, Leidos has approximately 50,000 employees globally and reported annual revenues of approximately $17.2 billion for the fiscal year ended January 2, 2026.
